# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

For a MacBook Pro, look for 100W or more of USB-C output and a capacity under 100Wh, which is the airline carry-on limit. Expect a full-size bank to recharge the laptop only about 70-75% because of conversion losses ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html)).

## My picks

**Best overall: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)**
- It has two 140W USB-C ports and 300W total output, so it can fast-charge two 16" MacBook Pros at once. It also recharges at up to 250W.
- It is airline-legal at 99.75Wh and has an app. It has no built-in cable, but a 240W cable is included.
- The list price is $229.99, with deals around $200.
- [Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html) and [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/) both link to current prices.

**Best with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**
- It has a retractable 140W USB-C cable, two 140W ports and two 65W ports. Macworld's test charged a 14" MacBook Pro about 1.2 times.
- It lists at $219.99, and WIRED showed about $190 on Amazon.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html)

**Best value: ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000mAh, 200W)**
- It has a built-in cable rated up to 140W and a three-year warranty, for about $120. ReelCharge is a new brand, so it is a bit riskier, and the bank itself only recharges at 100W.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)
- Macworld also recommends the INIU Cougar P64 140W as a value 140W option, but I don't have a price for it ([Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html)).

**Budget and lighter: Baseus Blade H1 (20,000mAh, 100W)**
- At $89.99 it is a good fit for a 14" MacBook Pro or Air. It is about 74Wh and carry-on legal, and it includes a 100W cable.
- It has a flat design and a 24-month warranty. Baseus says it reaches 50% in 30 minutes.
- [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you.

## Things to know for a 16" MacBook Pro
- Full 140W charging needs a PD 3.1 bank plus Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable. M4 and M5 models can also use a Thunderbolt 5 cable. Over a standard USB-C cable, older 16" models top out at 100W ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/819438/best-macbook-usb-c-charger.html)).
- A 14" MacBook Pro or Air is well served by 100W.
- Prices change often, so check the retailer at checkout.

If you tell me which MacBook Pro you have (14" or 16") and whether you fly with it, I can narrow this to one pick.
